candidates.reason: Defines StorageTestMixin.test_storage, which stores a cache entry with HTTPCACHE_EXPIRATION_SECS=1 and then expects the immediately following pre-expiry retrieval to succeed. A slow runner can exceed that one-second window before the retrieval, matching PR #7993's stated flake; the method is inherited by the filesystem, gzip filesystem, DBM, and custom DBM storage test classes.
